releaseNotes:
- App-wide theme persistence (Default / Dark / custom packs) from Settings and Deploy
- Material densify across MainWindow and sidebar pages (Database, Terminal, Git, History, Dashboard)
- Theme pack guide (THEME_PACK_GUIDE.md) ships with the app Themes folder
- Local terminal ConPTY typing fix and no bright band under the terminal
- Theme tokens for SQL editor completion and syntax highlighting
